functionProjection.reason: Preserve the runtime-validated M1/M2 managed projection, direction, UTF-8, bool, and ownership semantics while declarations remain generated from the normalized model.
functionProjection.risk: Changing these projections could regress the exact M1/M2 workflow validated at f1a11cfd1701a041cee29188f7600c85b34ae260.
functionProjection.plannedStage: Retain through M3; reconsider public object semantics only in M4.
functionProjection.coverage: M1/M2 unit, fake-native, representative TFM, ABI/export, and bounded official runtime evidence.

callbackOverrides.reason: Callback signatures are generated, but retention, exception containment, object state, and output-buffer rules require explicit policy rather than inferred marshalling.
callbackOverrides.risk: An unrooted delegate or exception crossing the native boundary can corrupt process state.
callbackOverrides.plannedStage: Low-level delegates remain internal in M3; any public callback object model is deferred beyond M4.
callbackOverrides.coverage: The M3 fake ABI probe exercises cdecl invocation, retention, exception-to-status containment, one-byte bool, size_t, UTF-8, borrowed pointer identity, output handle, and array length.
